test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct version of the following sentence.

He would be meet us next week

options.text: He would not be met us next week.
He will be meet us next week.
He will be meeting us next week.
He would be meets us next week.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct usage of the future continuous tense is “He will be meeting us next week.”
 
• This tense is used to indicate an action that will be happening at a certain time in the future.
 
• The given sentence is talking about a planned meeting in the future.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is “He will be meeting us next week.”

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He will be meeting us next week."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: “He would not be met us next week.”** – Incorrect due to improper use of conditional tense and incorrect verb form.
 
• **Option 2: “He will be meet us next week.”** – Incorrect due to incorrect verb form “meet” instead of “meeting”.
 
• **Option 4: “He would be meets us next week.”** – Incorrect due to improper use of conditional tense and incorrect verb form.
